ideas.pitch: A rapid Streamlit application that transforms messy Slack chat customer queries into a validated, review-ready invoice using Google Sheets pricing data.
ideas.problem_statement: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?
ideas.title: StreamLit InvoiceAgent Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 30% Functionality & Correctness criterion by strictly matching the required workflow and preventing AI price fabrication via database lookup.

ideas.pitch: A headless invoice automation backend built with FastAPI that parses unstructured client requests, checks Airtable for pricing, and generates a PDF review draft.
ideas.problem_statement: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?
ideas.title: FastAPI InvoiceFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins on the AI Implementation and Price Source Integration criteria by separating extraction logic from structural validation cleanly.

ideas.pitch: A React and Next.js interface with an integrated human-in-the-loop review step that takes natural language requirements and matches them against an Excel price book.
ideas.problem_statement: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?
ideas.title: Next.js InvoiceGen Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Excels in the Invoice Quality & Usability (15 Marks) and Real-World Usefulness (10 Marks) criteria by providing a polished front-end approval dashboard.

ideas.pitch: A standalone Python script utilizing Claude via LangChain to extract entities from messy emails and strictly enforce CSV-based pricing rules without hallucinations.
ideas.problem_statement: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?
ideas.title: Claude Invoice Builder with CSV Guardrails
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages superior prompt engineering and explicit fallback flags to satisfy the strict anti-fabrication constraint required by judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-latency invoice extraction and price-matching tool powered by Gemini that maps arbitrary natural language orders to an internal Airtable inventory.
ideas.problem_statement: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?
ideas.title: Gemini QuickInvoice Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and strict adherence to the required 5-step workflow: extraction, price lookup, generation, and review.
